title: Wogglims
summary: Firework that deals 3d6 Fire and can apply Colour Spray.

fields.Throw: Single-use Action. Sends a rocket at a target for 3d6 Fire. DC 12 Dexterity save prevents Colour Spray. The standard throw reaches up to 60 ft. The alternate inventory option reportedly has no explicit range limit.
fields.Colour Spray: Disadvantage on attacks and Advantage to attackers. Restricts attacks and most spells to 10 ft.
fields.Damage riders: Striking the firework can multiply Fire damage based on damage rider sources.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
